friendly_name: Per-mission-type path conventions and a narrow path waiver
purpose_context: Repositories without a src/ layout, such as content repositories, fail accept on software-dev path conventions. The only remap is project-wide and moves every mission type, and the only in-command escape (--lenient) also disables metadata validation. This Mission adds per-mission-type path-convention overrides, fail-closed validation of the new shape, remedy text that names the per-type remap first, and a narrow path-convention-only escape (#7566, #7748, #2330 item 1).
purpose_tldr: Let a project remap one mission type's paths without moving the others, and accept a layout mismatch without switching off metadata checks.
